authority: Spreadsheet is source of truth until a chat overwrites a named rule. Chat overwrites are listed in rulings[].
combat_flow: spin: pick a remaining monster at random (not empty slices)
player uses zero or more items
if enemy hp<=0 or defeated: skip enemy attack
else: hp = hp - max(0, enemy_atk - blk); Hornet would apply ATK twice (not in POC)
if hp==0: dying / healing potion check
defeat enemy, remove slice(s), neighbors close up
repeat until hp==0 or no monsters left

contradictions.special_function: Double the first BLK you gain or ATK you deal, then remove the trigger.

contradictions.ability: When you would die, discard this and Heal up to 3 HP.
contradictions.defined: If HP equals 0, discard and set HP to 4.

contradictions.ability: Adds 2 to the ATK of Neighboring monsters.
contradictions.function_flow: Set each neighbor ATK to Base ATK + 1.

contradictions.notes: Wraith text says it then receives ATK increase from Captain. Roster name is Commander.

contradictions.ability: ATK 7-X, X = Item count at start of combat.
contradictions.defined: Also describes HP Delta between player and enemy.
Describes Highest HP between you and the enemy.

contradictions.function_flow_atk_examples: Lists Sword. No Sword row in All Content.

contradictions.function_flow: (Is enemy HP less?) Set to 0 on spin - looks like a leftover, not a T/F check.
Apply ATK examples include Bracers. Ability is BLK X from weakest neighbor.

item_use_flow: can_use? else show Cannot Be Used
if defeat-on-use: jump to defeat enemy
increment items_used_this_combat; if >=2 set Two-Headed Serpent ATK to 0

items.ability: Atk 3, or Atk 1 and Keep this item
items.name: Throwing Knife

items.ability: Gain 4 Block.
items.name: Shield

items.ability: Flips 2 ↔ 4 after any Item is used.
items.exceptions: This should NOT start at 2 each fight, it should carry over its value between combats (not between dungeons eg adventure mode)
items.name: Sai

items.ability: Block equal to the HP you are missing.
items.name: Medallion

items.ability: Block equal to the lower HP between you and the Enemy.
items.defined: Lower HP wins; player value if tied. Recheck on HP change either side.
items.explainer: (the lower of YOUR HP and ENEMY HP)
items.name: Helmet

items.ability: Defeat an enemy with less HP than you. Combat ends immediately.
items.defined: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.
items.log_hint: Kill if they have less HP
items.name: The Boot

items.ability: Attack equal to the Attack of the last monster you faced.
items.defined: On Spin, store enemy ATK. Initial value is always 0.
items.name: Grimoire

items.ability: +1 ATK for each HP you are missing.
items.name: Bloody Wraps

items.ability: Gain 2 Block. If you lose HP this combat, Keep this Item.
items.defined: Tap on use. Discard on resolve unless HP dropped vs On Spin. Healing Potion this combat makes Did Lose HP always True.
items.explainer: Block 2 and Keep if you Bleed
items.name: Breastplate

items.ability: Block equal to the Neighboring enemy's Attack on the Right.
items.defined: On use, gain Block equal to the Attack of the neighboring enemy on your right. Unusable with no neighbor there.
items.exceptions: Final enemy: unusable.
items.name: Right Bracer

items.ability: Spin again and gain a Random Item.
items.defined: End combat without resolving. Spin again, not the same slice. Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic.
items.name: Smoke Bomb

items.ability: Attack equal to 8 minus the Items still in your hand.
items.defined: Also describes HP Delta (absolute difference of player vs enemy HP).
items.name: Knucklers

items.ability: Let the Enemy Attack, then Defeat them and Heal equal to their current HP.
items.defined: Store enemy HP on use. Fangs DMG can be blocked like Resolve Combat. Then heal stored HP. Player HP never exceeds 6. If this would kill you: Healing Potion, then Fangs Healing.
items.explainer:
Enemy Attacks, then 
Heal THEIR HP
items.name: Fangs

items.ability: Mark a Neighbor. When you spin them, they lose 5 HP immediately.
items.defined: Lose HP is not ATK dmg (can kill Goblin). Unusable with 0 neighbors. Crossbow-marked neighbors are not choosable.
items.name: Poison Flask

items.ability: Heal 6. On Spin, lose 1 HP.
items.defined: While in inventory unused, Lose 1 HP On Spin after combat has begun. Counts as Did Lose HP for Breastplate.
items.name: Cursed Scroll

items.ability: Take 2 Attack. If you still hold this when you Spin Spider Queen, discard it; she gains +2 HP and +2 Attack.
items.defined: Click during a fight. Take 2 Attack; Block works. Used up. If this is in hand when the wheel lands on Spider Queen, discard it and she gains +2 HP and +2 Attack. Queen does not create an Egg on the Spin that lands on her. Always created on other Spins while Queen is alive, up to 50 cards in hand.
items.exceptions: Not drafted. Queen creates it. Tier 0 so Merchant can turn it into a Tier 1 item.
items.flow: Click during a fight. Take 2 Attack; Block works. Used up. If this is in hand when the wheel lands on Spider Queen, discard it and she gains +2 HP and +2 Attack. Queen does not create an Egg on the Spin that lands on her. Always created on other Spins while Queen is alive, up to 50 cards in hand.
items.log_hint: Hurt you, or feed the Queen
items.name: Spider Egg
items.notes: Not drafted. Queen creates it. Tier 0 so Merchant can turn it into a Tier 1 item.

items.ability: This gains +2 Attack each time you lose any HP.
items.exceptions: Change to Base 0 ATK
items.name: Spiked Flail

items.ability: Unplayable. If you would die, discard this and Heal 3.
items.defined: If player HP ever equals 0, immediately Discard this item and set the player's HP to 4.
items.name: Healing Potion

items.ability: Deal 4 Attack to a Neighboring enemy.
items.defined: On use, choose a neighboring enemy. Deal 4 attack damage to them. If their HP reaches 0, they are defeated immediately. Unusable with 0 eligible neighbors.
items.name: Crossbow

items.ability: Defeat an enemy with 5 or more Attack. Combat ends immediately.
items.defined: When used, Resolve Combat immediately, skipping ATK/BLK resolution.
items.name: Sledgehammer

items.ability: Select an enemy. They Attack the enemy you are facing.
items.exceptions: Final enemy: unusable.
items.name: Pocketwatch

items.ability: Deal 2 Attack to the enemy you are facing and each Neighboring enemy. The same enemy is only hit once.
items.defined: On use, deal 2 ATK to the facing owner and each unique living neighbor. Two owners left: the other takes 2 once. Goblin ignores ATK. Used up.
items.name: Double Axe

items.ability: Heal 1, plus 1 for each monster Defeated
items.defined: On use in a fight, heal 1 + mobs_defeated, cap at 6 HP. Used up. Healing Potion still revives on death.
items.name: Victory Flask

items.ability: Swap a Neighboring Owner into this fight. Draw a Random Item.
items.defined: On use, pick a living neighbor. Swap that owner with the facing owner. Keep current block, items-used, and snapshots. Draw one item from the remaining pool if any. Used up.
items.name: Grappling Hook

items.ability: Deal 2 Attack, or gain 2 Block.
items.defined: On use, choose ATK 2 or BLK 2. Used up either way.
items.exceptions: Art is a stand-in until a spiked shield tile exists.
items.name: Spiked Shield

items.ability: Each time you Spin, Lose 1 HP and this item gains +2 Block
items.defined: While in hand and not spent: at combat start, player loses 1 HP (counts as a bleed for Spiked Flail) and this card's block number +2. On use, gain that much block, then used up. Starts at 0.
items.explainer: On Spin: Lose 1 HP, this Gains 2 Block
items.log_hint: Each Spin: lose HP, gain Block
items.name: Grief Jar

items.ability: Deal 4 Attack to the monster across from you (only works if even # of monsters remaining)
items.defined: Usable in a fight only when living slice count is even. Deal 4 ATK to the opposite slice. Goblin ignores ATK. Odd count: cannot use. Used up.
items.name: Longbow

items.ability: (ATK 2), then return to your hand.
items.defined: Do not discard on use; Tap. Untap always occurs On Resolve Combat.
items.name: Dagger

items.ability: (BLK X), where X is the lowest HP between you and the enemy.
items.defined: Older check: only enemy HP change, not player HP. Hidden/retired.
items.name: Helmet

items.ability: At the start of each combat, lose 1 HP.
items.name: Bandana

items.ability: Heal 2. Keep this if you are still missing HP.
items.defined: Click during a fight. Heal 2, cap 6. If HP is still below 6, keep the card. If you are already at 6, heal 0 and the card is used up. Counts as an item use.
items.exceptions: Breastplate keeps if you bled. This keeps if you are still hurt after the heal.
items.name: Lantern

items.ability: Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained.
items.defined: Click during a fight. Gain Block equal to the last Block you gained this dungeon. If you have not gained Block yet this dungeon, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up. Counts as an item use.
items.exceptions: Last Block is the amount from the last time you gained Block, not your current Block total.
items.name: Mirror Shard

items.ability: The facing owner's Attack becomes 0 this fight.
items.defined: Click during a fight. Set facing Attack to 0 and lock it for the rest of this fight, including after Commander and Harpy formulas. They still leave after Done. Used up.
items.exceptions: Dragon pierce of 0 is 0. Kobold still swings twice for 0.
items.name: Caltrops

items.ability: Becomes a copy of the last item you used.
items.defined: In hand this looks like the last item you used this dungeon (faint Echo icon). Click it to use that copy, then Echo is used up even if the original had Keep. If you have not used an item this dungeon, it is Unplayable.
items.exceptions: Updates when you use an item. Cube feed is not an item use. First fight of a run: Unplayable.
items.name: Echo Bell

items.ability: Remove your Enemy's unique ability
items.defined: Click during a fight. That owner id loses its unique ability and formulas for the rest of this dungeon. They show printed ATK/HP like Golem. If they have no unique ability, the click does nothing and the card stays. Used up otherwise.
items.exceptions: Golem: cannot click. Bandit and other formulas fall back to the ATK/HP columns.
items.name: Quiet Bell

items.ability: Choose to reduce the facing owner's Attack by 1, 2, or 3.
items.defined: Click during a fight, then click 1, 2, or 3. Facing Attack drops by that much after every other formula including Commander, floors at 0, then locks for the rest of this fight. Used up.
items.exceptions: Caltrops is retired. This is the milder version, last in calc.
items.name: Net

items.ability: Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. Keep this item.
items.defined: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to Block you hold. You keep that Block. This item Keeps. Unplayable at 0 Block. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
items.exceptions: Hornet and Queen still Attack after. You still hold the Block for those swings.
items.name: Chain

items.defined: Click during a fight. Deal Attack equal to the dungeon cycle number (1, then 2, then 3, then 4, then 1). Every item use this dungeon advances that number, including this click. The cycle carries across fights and resets on the next dungeon. Two Beads share one number. Used up. Counts as an item use. Goblin cannot take Attack damage.
items.exceptions: Cube feed is not an item use, so the cycle does not advance. Anvil takes 1 from this Attack.
items.name: Counting Beads

items.ability: If you have zero items that deal Atk damage, Defeat the enemy.
items.defined: Click during a fight. If you hold no items that deal Attack, Defeat them. This card is not an Attack item. Unplayable if any other card in hand deals Attack. Used up when it works. Counts as an item use. Gargoyle cannot be Defeated.
items.exceptions: Holding only this works. Echo copying an Attack item counts as an Attack item. Shield alone is enough.
items.log_hint: Win if you have no Attack
items.name: Paci-Fist

items.ability: Defeat any Monster with exactly double your HP
items.defined: Click during a fight, then click any monster on the wheel (including the one you are facing). If that monster's HP is exactly twice yours, Defeat them. If they are not the one you are fighting, they leave and this fight keeps going. Grey if nobody matches. Same animation as The Boot and Sledgehammer. Used up.
items.name: Scythe

items.ability: Choose 2 Items and replace them with random Items of the same Tier.
items.defined: Click during a fight, then click other items in your hand. If you hold only one other item, reroll that one. If you hold two or more, pick two. Each becomes a random item of that item's tier, with the same motion as Adventure Mode starter upgrades. This card cannot target itself. Unplayable if this is the only item in your hand. Used up. Counts as an item use.
items.exceptions: Does not deal Attack. Gargoyle petrify does not pick this. Cube feed is not this.
items.name: Chaos Stone

items.ability: Block equal to the Neighboring enemy's Attack on the Left.
items.defined: On use, gain Block equal to the Attack of the neighboring enemy on your left. Unusable with no neighbor there.
items.exceptions: Final enemy: unusable.
items.name: Left Bracer

items.ability: Atk 3. While in hand, your Attacks deal +1 Dmg and Enemy Attacks ignore your Block.
items.defined: Click during a fight. Deal 3 Attack, plus 1 more for each Arrow Head still in hand (this copy counts, so one copy deals 4). Used up. Counts as an item use. While any unspent copy is in hand (petrified still counts), every item Attack number gets +1 after that item's own formula, then Goblin / Anvil / Hollow / King / Bodyguard apply as they already do. Enemy attacks ignore Block the way Dragon does (Block is not eaten), including Hornet extras, Needleback, Damsel neighbors, Harpy, Kobold, Wick, and Fangs. Spider Egg becomes Take 3; Block still works on that self-hit. After you click this card it is gone, so Harpy's poke can be Blocked. Quiet Bell does not turn this off. Tutorial does not seat it.
items.exceptions: Bucket 7. Two copies each add +1. Take X / Done uses the ignore-Block math. Echo Bell that is a copy of this also runs the aura.
items.name: Arrow Head

items.ability: Choose Highest Attack, Lowest Attack, or Off. The next Spin lands on that monster, then discard this.
items.defined: Click at Ready or during a fight. Three pills: Highest Attack, Lowest Attack, Off. Highest or Lowest arms this copy. Off clears the arm. Attack numbers are read at Spin after formulas. Ties pick at random among those Attack values. The next Spin (button, auto-spin after a fight, Smoke Bomb, Commander flee, Wick, Vampire shuffle) lands on that monster, then this copy is discarded. Tutorial scripted landings ignore it and do not discard it. Two copies: the most recently set Highest or Lowest wins; copies armed that way are discarded; the other mode stays. Quiet Bell does not turn this off. Not in the tutorial kit.
items.exceptions: Bucket 4. Count 1. No Attack. Petrified still steers if already armed.
items.name: Danger Magnet

items.exceptions: Bucket 1. Flee skips their Attack (Hornet never swings).
items.notes: Bucket 1. Flee skips their Attack (Hornet never swings).
items.name: Shuriken
items.ability: 2 Attack. If the Enemy lives, you Flee and Keep this.
items.explainer: (ATK 2) Flee and Keep if they live
items.defined: Click during a fight. Deal 2 Attack. Needleback and Harpy still apply. If they still have HP, you Flee (Spin at random, can be the same monster) and Keep this. If they hit 0, this is used up and you do not Flee. Goblin ignores Attack so they live. Fight only.
items.log_hint: 2 Attack, Flee and Keep if they live

items.exceptions: Bucket 4. Poison sources add. Flask is +5 on a neighbor.
items.notes: Bucket 4. Poison sources add. Flask is +5 on a neighbor.
items.name: Miasma
items.ability: Apply Poison to all Monsters equal to the lowest HP on any Monster
items.explainer: Poison all for the lowest HP
items.defined: Click during a fight. Read current HP of every living monster, take the lowest, add that much Poison to every living monster. Plague Doctor neighbors stay at 2. The facing enemy ticks immediately (lose that HP, mark clears). If that slays them, combat ends. Other marks tick on a later Spin, then clear. Fight only. Used up.
items.log_hint: Poison everyone for the lowest HP

items.exceptions: Bucket 3. Marble is a Token, not drafted.
items.notes: Bucket 3. Marble is a Token, not drafted.
items.name: Bag of Marbles
items.ability: Fill your inventory with Marbles
items.explainer: Fill empty seats to 10 with Marbles
items.defined: Click during a fight. Used up. Then fill empty seats with Marble tokens until the hand has 10 cards, even in the 50-seat dungeon. Facing Basilisk: this is spent and you Gain none. Fight only.

items.exceptions: Created by Bag of Marbles. Merchant treats Tier 0 like Egg.
items.notes: Created by Bag of Marbles. Merchant treats Tier 0 like Egg.
items.name: Marble
items.ability: Gain 0 Atk or 0 Block randomly. On Spin, increase these numbers by 1
items.defined: Token. Not an Attack item until it declares Attack. Click during a fight: a callout names Attack or Block at random, then that number fires. 0 can be clicked and is used up. Each Marble has its own number starting at 0. Every Spin each Marble in hand +1. New dungeon resets to 0. Used up on click.
items.log_hint: Random Attack or Block, grows on Spin

items.exceptions: Bucket 6. Skull + number on the card.
items.notes: Bucket 6. Skull + number on the card.
items.name: Hex
items.ability: Unplayable. Defeats the Monster 6 Spins from now.
items.defined: Unplayable. Starts at 6. Every Spin (Smoke, Flee, auto-spin, landing) the number drops by 1. At 1 it flashes red. On the Spin that hits 0, Defeat the landed enemy with no HP chip (like The Boot). Gargoyle is Defeated. Commander can still Flee. Two Hexes at 0 both spend, one Defeat. Hex fires before poison on that landing. New dungeon resets to 6. Used up when it fires.

items.name: Ale Flagon
items.ability: Heal 5. Gain 3 Poison.
items.defined: Click during a fight. Used up. Heal 5 (cap 6). Gain 3 Poison; amounts add. Droplet with the number sits next to your HP. Next Spin: facing monster’s poison ticks first and clears, then you lose HP equal to your poison and it clears. Block does not stop it. If that Spin already finished the last monster, skip your tick (victory). Healing Potion still saves a 0; poison is already gone. New dungeon wipes leftover poison. Any Spin counts.
items.exceptions: Bucket 6. Same droplet as monster poison.
items.notes: Bucket 6. Same droplet as monster poison.

keywords.atk_dmg: HP loss from ATK. Goblin ignores this.
keywords.defeat: Remove the enemy without that ATK-to-0 path (Da Boot, Sledgehammer, Fangs, Poison Flask).
keywords.enemy_attacks: Sheet: always, no exceptions among monsters. Items can prevent the attack by killing/defeating first (not by blocking).
keywords.flee: If you are facing them, Spin the wheel at random.
keywords.kill: Reduce HP to 0 with ATK damage.
keywords.spin: The wheel lands on a random living monster.

monsters.ability: I cannot take Attack damage.
monsters.defined: This unit's HP can never be reduced. Note that this unit can be defeated through all other means.
monsters.name: Goblin

monsters.ability: I copy the HP of the last enemy you faced.
monsters.defined: On Spin (and after On Spin effects, especially Spider Queen's Egg effect or Ogre's Empath updates), immediately store the enemy's HP in this value. Overwrite each On Spin.
monsters.exceptions: If this is the first unit faced, set HP to 3.
monsters.name: Skeleton

monsters.ability: I Attack twice.
monsters.defined: On Resolve Combat, takes its current ATK and deals dmg to the player two times. There should be no special or unique interaction with BLK, this should attack in a logically consistent way to if two enemies simply attacked the player, one after the other. For example, the player may actually BLEED twice if both attacks cause the player to lose health.
monsters.name: Hornet Swarm

monsters.ability: I give my Neighbors +1 HP.
monsters.defined: Set each neighbor's HP to its (Max HP + 1).
monsters.function_flow: Set each neighbor's HP to its (Max HP + 1).
monsters.name: Lich

monsters.ability: When you lose HP, I lose equal HP.
monsters.name: Ogre

monsters.ability: Every time you lose HP, I gain +1 HP and +1 ATK.
monsters.defined: Each time the player's HP number goes down, every living Vampire on the wheel gains +1 current HP, +1 max HP, and +1 Attack. A 4-heart hit is still +1/+1. A fully blocked hit does nothing. Healing does not remove the bonus. The bonus stays until that Vampire dies or leaves. Quiet Bell stops further gains and keeps the HP and Attack already gained. The new Attack is for the next swing.
monsters.exceptions: Once per hit or bleed, not once per heart. Every copy on the wheel.
monsters.explainer: +1 HP and +1 ATK each time you lose HP
monsters.name: Vampire
monsters.notes: Once per hit or bleed, not once per heart. Every copy on the wheel.

monsters.ability: I alternate between 3, 4, and 8 Atk every time you Spin.

atk.formula: Alternates between 3, 4, and 8 Atk on Spin

monsters.name: Berserker

monsters.ability: My Attack always equals your HP.
monsters.name: Dire Wolf

monsters.ability: +1 Atk for each Item you hold.
monsters.name: Bandit

monsters.ability: On Spin, repeatedly Heals the Lowest HP Monster until it equals the HP of another Monster.
monsters.explainer: Lowest HP Monster +1 until tied with another
monsters.log_hint: Raises lowest HP Monster until it equals another Monster
monsters.name: Leech League
monsters.reminder: Lowest HP Monster = 2nd Lowest HP Monster

monsters.ability: I copy the higher ATK of my Neighbors
monsters.defined: Resolve order: the only function whose order of operations matters. Match higher neighbor ATK (with their complete modifiers), then receive the ATK increase from Captain.
monsters.name: Wraith

monsters.ability: If I go down before I Attack, you gain an Item.
monsters.defined: Did It Attack? starts False. Set True if the enemy ever attacks. Prevent by killing or defeating with items (not blocking). Draw 1 unseen item, tier-agnostic. If pool empty, draw nothing.
monsters.log_hint: Drops an item if you kill it
monsters.name: Mimic

monsters.ability: My Neighbors will attack you (Left, then Right), then I will Heal you for 3 HP.
monsters.name: Damsel In Distress

monsters.ability: My Attack always equals my HP.
monsters.exceptions: Only unit whose ATK can change mid-combat. Damaging it affects Sai, Fangs, Sledgehammer.
monsters.name: Slime Boss

monsters.ability: Each time you Spin, Gain 1 Spider Egg. Spinning me discards those eggs; I gain +2 HP and +2 Attack for each.
monsters.defined: (Changed) Only attacks once, no more double attack.
monsters.explainer: Spider Egg: an Item that on use deals you 2 Atk, or is devoured by the Queen to give her +2 HP and +2 ATK
monsters.log_hint: Gives you an Egg each Spin
monsters.name: Spider Queen

monsters.ability: I give my Neighbors +2 Attack. The first time I am Defeated, I Flee.
monsters.defined: Set each neighbor ATK to Base ATK + 1.
monsters.function_flow: Set each neighbor ATK to Base ATK + 1.
monsters.name: Commander

monsters.ability: My Attack ignores Block.
monsters.name: Dragon
monsters.special_function: On Spin, double the first BLK the player gains or ATK they deal, then remove trigger.

monsters.ability: I Attack you for 1 Damage each time I take ATK Damage.
monsters.defined: ATK 3, HP 5. Each time this owner receives ATK damage (including a killing blow), the player takes 1 ATK; block applies. Defeat and poison do not poke. Goblin-style immunity does not apply to this owner.
monsters.exceptions: Portrait is a 0x72 wogol stand-in until a porcupine/toad tile exists.
monsters.log_hint: Hits you when it takes Attack
monsters.name: Needleback

monsters.ability: I make you feed me one of two items.
monsters.defined: On spin, if you have 0 items, nothing. If 1, you must feed that one. If 2 or more, two random items are offered and you must feed one. The discard is not an item use. ATK/HP unchanged.
monsters.exceptions: Not an item use: no Kobold extra, no Echo update, no Harpy after the feed.
monsters.log_hint: Makes you feed it an item
monsters.name: Gelatinous Cube
monsters.reminder: feed me one of two items

monsters.ability: I petrify your highest Attack item until you Spin again.
monsters.defined: After spin numbers, the highest Attack item in hand becomes Unplayable until the next Spin. Tie is random. No Attack items: nothing. Longbow and Spiked Shield count. Boot and Poison Flask do not. Smoke is a new Spin, so it clears. Attack still works. Cannot be Defeated unless Quiet Bell has silenced me.
monsters.exceptions: Petrify tooltip: Unplayable until your next Spin.
monsters.name: Gargoyle

monsters.ability: I attack you when your Spin lands on me, and after each item you use.
monsters.defined: On spin, one swing of my current Attack (Block works). After each item fully resolves, if I am still alive, one more swing. Ceases when you click Done or I am Defeated/Slain. Done still takes the normal hit. Not Attack = Block.
monsters.exceptions: One swing, fight stays open. If an item already killed me, no extra swing.
monsters.log_hint: Hits on meet and after items
monsters.name: Harpy

monsters.ability: I attack an extra time for each item you use this fight.
monsters.defined: On Done, swing count is 1 plus items used this fight. Cube feed does not count. Block is spent per swing.
monsters.exceptions: 0 items = 1 swing. 2 items = 3 swings.
monsters.name: Kobold Trapper

monsters.ability: If I live, I leave two Tough Monsters in my place.
monsters.defined: If you do not Defeat or Slay me, I leave and two random Tier 2 owners sit immediately, even if that grows the wheel past 8. You are not in a new fight yet.
monsters.exceptions: Quiet Bell strips this: I leave like anyone else, no heirs.
monsters.name: Clockwork Knight

monsters.ability: While facing me, you cannot Gain or Keep any Items.
monsters.defined: While you fight me, Keep does not work. Every item you use is discarded immediately. Knife nick, Lantern, and Breastplate leave your hand. Quiet Bell strips this.
monsters.exceptions: Keep after the fight is already over does not apply — the toss happens when you click.
monsters.name: Basilisk

monsters.ability: Attack or Block values that are Even happen twice against me.
monsters.defined: While you fight me, an even Attack number hits me twice as two separate Attacks of that number. An even Block you gain while facing me is gained twice. Odd numbers happen once. Quiet Bell strips this.
monsters.exceptions: Anvil would take 1 from each of those two Attacks. Poison Flask is not an Attack.
monsters.name: Twins

monsters.ability: I gain Atk equal to your leftmost Atk Item

atk.formula: Base Atk (0) + Leftmost Item with an Atk value

monsters.defined: My Attack is the live Attack number on your leftmost item that has an Attack number, after the usual hand sort, skipping cards with no Attack number. It updates on Spin and when you use an item. If you have no such item, my Attack is 3. Quiet Bell: printed Attack.
monsters.exceptions: Spent cards are skipped. Petrified cards have no Attack number for this.
monsters.name: Beggar

monsters.ability: I Lose 2 HP each time a Neighbor is Defeated
monsters.defined: When a Neighbor's fight ends as Defeated, Slain, or Blocked, I lose 2 HP. Flee (Cowardly King, Commander) does not count. If this drops me to 0 HP, I am Defeated.
monsters.name: Wick

monsters.ability: I cannot lose more than 1 HP at a time.
monsters.defined: I cannot lose more than 1 HP from one source. Attack, Poison Flask, and other HP loss each chip 1. Defeat still works. Two separate Attacks chip 1 twice. Quiet Bell strips this, so full Attack lands.
monsters.exceptions: Needleback poke is not an Item hitting me. Poison Flask is not an Attack. Extra Attacks each chip 1.
monsters.log_hint: Loses only 1 HP at a time
monsters.name: Anvil

monsters.ability: When my Neighbors would take Attack Damage, I take it instead
monsters.defined: When a neighbor would take Attack damage, I take that hit instead. Each Bodyguard does this once per hit, so a line of them passes it to the last Bodyguard. The pass is shown before HP changes. Double Axe adds my own hit and each neighbor's hit onto that end. If the hit was aimed at the Twins, the number doubles first. A hit aimed at Goblin still comes to me. If I die while I am not the one you are facing, I leave like a Crossbow kill. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.exceptions: Bucket 2. Right is counterclockwise when a King is also passing. Goblin still shows Immune to Attack Damage when the hit actually lands on Goblin.
monsters.name: Bodyguard

monsters.ability: When you Attack me, my Neighbor to the Right takes it instead. When I attack, I Flee before being Defeated.
monsters.defined: Attack damage aimed at me goes to the next living monster on my right, counterclockwise. Other Kings pass it on. Each King does this once per hit. A loop means nobody takes that damage. If I am the only monster, I take it. If the walk ends on Goblin, Goblin takes 0 and shows Immune to Attack Damage, unless a Bodyguard then takes the hit. Bodyguards pass once each to the end of their line. The walk is shown before HP changes. Double Axe's own hit and my passed hit both land. Poison Flask, defeat items, and Net still hit me. After I attack from Take or Safe, I stay on the wheel, I am not counted as defeated, and the wheel spins again. Damsel's neighbors already stay, so that does not stack. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.exceptions: Bucket 9. One Poison Flask deals 5, so a fresh King is left at 1 HP. Flee here means he stays after his own attack. It is not Commander's shuffle.
monsters.explainer: Right Neighbor takes the hit. I stay after I attack.
monsters.log_hint: Hits you and flees if hurt
monsters.name: Cowardly King
monsters.notes: Bucket 9. One Poison Flask leaves him at 1 HP.

monsters.ability: When you Spin me, choose an Item and I will upgrade it
monsters.defined: After Spin, and after Spider Queen lays an egg, every item in hand that still has a remaining copy in this dungeon’s item pile of the next tier gets a button. That copy is used up. Tier 0 becomes Tier 1, Tier 1 becomes Tier 2, Tier 2 becomes Tier 3, Tier 3 stays Tier 3. You cannot go over a card’s copy count. You must pick one of those buttons before using items or Done. Clicking an item with nothing legal left leaves it as it is; you still pick a different item. If no item has a legal upgrade, nothing. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.exceptions: Bucket 4. Remaining dungeon pile, that copy is used up. Two Sais is legal. A third is not. A new Spider Egg laid on this spin can be picked if a Tier 1 copy is still in the pile.
monsters.explainer: Choose an item. I upgrade it.
monsters.name: Merchant
monsters.notes: Bucket 4. Remaining dungeon pile, that copy is used up. Two Sais is legal. A third is not. A new Spider Egg laid on this spin can be picked if a Tier 1 copy is still in the pile.
monsters.reminder: Choose an item. I upgrade it.

monsters.ability: When you face me, Gain a Shield
monsters.defined: Only a real Spin onto me. I walk to the closest empty hotbar slot, you Gain a Shield (a fresh extra copy), then the bar re-sorts into the Block group. Grappling Hook and Damsel neighbors do not pay. Quiet Bell turns this off. Hand at 50: skip.
monsters.exceptions: Bucket 8. The Shield is the live Shield card. You can click it this fight.
monsters.name: Juggernaut
monsters.notes: Bucket 8. The Shield is the live Shield card. You can click it this fight.
monsters.reminder: When you face me, Gain a Shield.

monsters.ability: After you Spin, if you are missing at least 3 HP I will Heal you for 3 and take your worst Item
monsters.defined: After every Spin while a living unsilenced Cleric is on the wheel. Automatic On Spin first (Cursed Scroll, Grief Jar, Harpy, poison, leech, Queen eggs, Juggernaut). Then if you are still alive and missing at least 3 HP, each Cleric in seat order: if still missing 3, Heal 3 and delete the lowest-tier item (ties random, Egg tier 0). Empty hand still Heals 3. Then Merchant or Cube may ask. Take, Done, and fight chips do not trigger this. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.exceptions: Bucket 6. Spider Egg is Tier 0. Missing 3 HP means 3 hearts or fewer. Two Clerics: the second only pays if you are still missing 3 after the first Heal 3.
monsters.explainer: After Spin: if missing 3 HP, Heal 3 and take worst item
monsters.name: Cleric
monsters.reminder: After you Spin, if missing 3 HP, Heal 3 and I take your worst item.

monsters.exceptions: Bucket 6. Wick, Berserker, Victory Flask, Mimic count this Defeat. Mimic does not gift because I already Attacked.
monsters.notes: Bucket 6. Wick, Berserker, Victory Flask, Mimic count this Defeat. Mimic does not gift because I already Attacked.
monsters.reminder: When I Attack, I die. Neighbors gain my HP.
monsters.name: Martyr
monsters.ability: When I Attack, I die. My Neighbors each gain HP equal to my current HP
monsters.explainer: On Attack: I die. Neighbors gain my HP
monsters.defined: 0 Attack still Attacks. Snapshot HP, then I die as a Defeat. Each living neighbor gains that much current HP and max HP (like Vampire). Empty seats skipped. Killing me with items before Done skips this. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.log_hint: Dies on Attack, neighbors gain that HP

monsters.exceptions: Bucket 4. Double Axe and bows still refract the share aimed at me.
monsters.notes: Bucket 4. Double Axe and bows still refract the share aimed at me.
monsters.reminder: Attack at me hits both neighbors instead.
monsters.name: Prism
monsters.ability: When I would take Attack damage, both of my Neighbors take it instead.
monsters.defined: When Attack would hit me, I take 0. Living neighbors take that Attack as if you attacked them, left (clockwise) first, then right. One living neighbor takes the full hit once. Zero living neighbors: I take it. A loop (two Prisms) fizzles that share. Needleback, Twins, Bodyguard, Goblin, Anvil apply on the one who actually takes it. Poison, Boot, Sledgehammer still hit me. Quiet Bell turns this off.

monsters.exceptions: Bucket 5. Always is the live keyword.
monsters.notes: Bucket 5. Always is the live keyword.
monsters.reminder: Neighbors Always have 2 Poison. On Spin I heal them 2.
monsters.name: Plague Doctor
monsters.ability: My Neighbors Always have 2 Poison. When you Spin, I heal my Neighbors for 2.
monsters.explainer: Neighbors Always 2 Poison. Spin: they Heal 2
monsters.defined: While I live unsilenced, each living neighbor's Poison is exactly 2. Extra Poison cannot raise them. Every Spin: facing poison ticks first (then clears; I write 2 again if they lived). Then I heal each living neighbor +2 current HP and +2 max HP. A 2 HP neighbor dies to poison before the heal. When I die, Always ends and the 2 goes away. Quiet Bell turns this off.
monsters.log_hint: Neighbors Always 2 Poison, heal 2 on Spin

monsters.name: Hired Hand
monsters.ability: If you Discard an item when facing me, I will Attack one of my Neighbors and Flee.
monsters.explainer: Discard an item: I Attack a Neighbor and Flee.
monsters.defined: After Spin, overlay. Click any card in hand (Hex, Potion, Egg, Marble, petrified) to Discard it. That is not an item use. I deal my Attack to one living Neighbor at random (Pocketwatch rules: Needleback hits me). Then I Flee. No living Neighbors: Decline only, I do not Flee. Empty hand: overlay, Decline only, then a snarky line and we fight. Quiet Bell turns this off. Decline: snark, then ordinary combat.
monsters.exceptions: Bucket 6. Flee keeps the live tooltip.
monsters.log_hint: Pay an item, I hit a Neighbor and Flee
monsters.reminder: Discard an item: I Attack a Neighbor and Flee.
monsters.notes: Bucket 6. Flee keeps the live tooltip.

monsters.name: Hydra
monsters.ability: I Petrify all Items with an Even Atk or Blk value and Gain +2 Atk for each
monsters.explainer: Petrify even Attack and Block. +2 Attack each.
monsters.defined: When you Spin me (same moment as Gargoyle, before Queen eggs and Juggernaut Shield): look at the live Attack or Block number on each item in hand. Egg counts. 0 is even. Heal, Defeat, Poison, Hex, Potion, Bag, Magnet, and Smoke do not. Even numbers are Petrified (Unplayable until your next Spin, same overlay as Gargoyle). Then I Gain +2 Attack for each item petrified this landing. That Attack stays on me for the dungeon and stacks if you Spin me again. Quiet Bell after I fired: I keep the Attack; I will not Petrify or Gain on a later landing. Quiet Bell before I fire: this landing does nothing.
monsters.exceptions: Bucket 7. Petrify tooltip is Gargoyle’s: Unplayable until your next Spin.
monsters.reminder: Petrify even Attack and Block. +2 Attack each.
monsters.notes: Bucket 7. Petrify tooltip is Gargoyle’s: Unplayable until your next Spin.

poc.notes: Vanilla ATK/HP plus one BLK, one ATK-with-choice, one ATK-with-condition. No neighbors, no draft, no defeat-on-use.

rulings.rule: When resolving enemy ATK vs BLK, leftover damage floors at 0. Sheet does not say. POC uses max(0, enemy_atk - blk).
Function Flow Resolve Combat step 4: after you kill them with items OR survive their hit, the slice is removed. POC follows that: not a multi-round HP slog.
Place Starters: four starter-rarity monsters auto-seat at N, E, S, W. Four starter items (always including Smoke Bomb) drop into the hotbar. Player does not click starter seats.

Mill gate: mystery silhouette, item shown, matching-tier threat. Take the relic to slam the door open, reveal the monster, then click an empty alcove. Three passes. After the last pass, remaining alcoves and relics auto-fill. Combat never starts with empty alcoves. Packs still roll 40/35/25; item matches monster tier.
Sai alternates 2 and 4 each time any item is used. Starts at 2 each combat. Deals the current value, then the flip applies to later cards.
Knucklers is 7 minus unspent items in hand, live on item use. Not locked at combat start.
Spiked Flail is ATK 2 + 1 per HP-loss event this dungeon (any amount in one hit counts as one). Not kills.

Four starter-rarity monsters. Four starter items: one is always Smoke Bomb, then three more starter-rarity items. Draft is mystery-gate packs until the wheel is full, with three passes then auto-fill.
Hornet Swarm and Spider Queen resolve two separate swings. Block is spent on the first swing (ATK 2 vs BLK 2 blocks the first and leaves BLK 0; the second swing deals 2).
